name: Port Blair
crossing: Veer Savarkar Airport, you land here
bestFor: Cellular Jail · Aberdeen bazaar · Corbyn's Cove
note: Every trip in the chain starts here. Build in a full day before you hop south — the jail's light-and-sound show is worth staying awake for.

name: Ross Island
bestFor: Colonial ruins · Spotted deer · Sky walk
note: A British plantation swallowed by strangler figs. Free of crowds before 9am, and the deer have stopped being shy.

name: Baratang
crossing: 3-hour drive on the Andaman Trunk Road
bestFor: Limestone caves · Mud volcano · Jolly Ropo creek
note: The trunk road runs through a tribal reserve with timed convoy windows, so this one leaves early. The mangrove creek is the only navigable one in India.

name: Havelock
bestFor: Radhanagar Beach · Elephant Bay snorkelling · Bamboo get
note: The reason most people book. Two nights minimum — one sunset at Radhanagar and one full morning at Elephant Beach before the tour boats arrive.

name: Neil Island
crossing: 15 minutes from Havelock, 2.5 hours from base
bestFor: Natural Bridge · Bharata and Laxmanpur · Krushna Beach
note: Smaller, slower, no cars. Cycle the perimeter in an afternoon and take the last light at Krushna on the north shore.
